local.h: Judge skeptical of detainee relocation challenge
local.b: A federal judge questioned claims that moving pretrial detainees to Irwin County violates their rights. Nearly all 400 are already there.
local.title: Federal judge questions harm in relocating detainees to South Georgia

local.h: Court lets Georgia kids' social media law take effect
local.b: An 11th Circuit panel voided an injunction against the Protecting Georgia's Children on Social Media Act, ruling NetChoice was unlikely to win.
local.title: Court lifts block on GA law restricting children’s social media access

local.h: 11 roller coasters halted after Six Flags death
local.b: Investigators are probing how Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, 42, fell from the Goliath at Six Flags Over Georgia. Nine of the halted coasters share its maker and restraint design.

local.b: Nearly 12,000 rowers from more than 30 countries are competing in the three-day regatta, which organizers say will go on rain or shine.

local.h: 4 Chicago-area congressional offices get suspicious letters
local.b: Reps. Brad Schneider, Mike Quigley, Robin Kelly and Jan Schakowsky reported letters amid a national wave of threats before Election Day.
local.title: 4 Chicago area congressional offices receive suspicious letters amid wave of preelection threats

local.h: Chicago bids to host 2031 Women's World Cup
local.b: Mayor Johnson sent a letter supporting the bid to U.S. Soccer. The city passed twice on hosting the men's World Cup over taxpayer costs.
local.title: Chicago puts in bid to host 2031 FIFA Women's World Cup

local.h: Big money floods Chicago school board races
local.b: Groups backed by wealthy, often suburban donors have outraised the Chicago Teachers Union 5 to 1 ahead of the Nov. 3 election.
local.title: Cash floods CPS School Board races, with big money groups outraising the Chicago Teachers Union 5 to 1

local.h: Metra plan would add crosstown, frequent trains
local.b: The $9 billion plan would run trains every 15 to 30 minutes and connect the south and west suburbs directly to O'Hare for the first time.

local.h: Johnson signs order on seniors' rights
local.b: The executive order spells out seniors' rights to housing, health care and services and creates a Mayor's Office on Aging.

local.h: Johnson's campaign cash dips below $380,000
local.b: Mayor Brandon Johnson raised $122,980 from July to September, while frontrunner Alexi Giannoulias has $19 million, new filings show.

local.h: Bridgeport, Chinatown push back on rail yard move
local.b: Residents are rallying against plans to relocate Amtrak's South Loop facility to their neighborhoods to make room for a White Sox ballpark backed by Justin Ishbia.

local.h: Suits say delivery robots collect biometric data
local.b: Proposed class actions accuse Coco Robotics and Serve Robotics of scanning customers' faces and hands without consent. Both companies deny it.
local.title: Lawsuits accuse Chicago delivery robot companies of collecting biometric data

local.h: Lawmakers: little progress at Adelanto ICE facility
local.b: Members of Congress who toured the facility Friday described unsanitary showers and kitchens, inedible food and poor medical care.
local.title: Reps say Adelanto has made little progress on unsanitary conditions

local.h: Norte Fire burns homes in South Orange County
local.b: The fire near San Clemente spread to 465 acres Friday, burning at least four homes and prompting evacuations in San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano.
local.title: Norte Fire burns 6 homes in South Orange County

local.h: LA controller subpoenas LA28 over finances
local.b: Controller Kenneth Mejia demanded the Olympics committee hand over documents on its contracts and venue budgets after it left a contract list out of its report.
local.title: LA city controller subpoenas LA28, demanding financial documents

local.h: LA fire survivors to lose case managers
local.b: About 1,400 households hit by the 2025 fires will lose disaster case managers by the end of October amid a California-FEMA funding standoff.

local.h: Brewers sweep Dodgers out of the NLCS
local.b: Garrett Mitchell's go-ahead homer in the sixth lifted Milwaukee to a 6-4 Game 4 win and its first World Series trip since 1982.

local.h: Bryson Fire forces Malibu evacuations
local.b: Residents near Kanan Dume and Encinal Canyon roads were ordered to evacuate. The fire had grown to 80 acres as of 6:15 p.m. Thursday.
local.title: Bryson Fire prompts evacuation orders in Malibu. Containment grows to 39%

local.h: Henderson Fire closes 5 Freeway near Camp Pendleton
local.b: The fire burned more than 1,100 acres, forcing evacuations on parts of the base and closing the 5 between Oceanside and Basilone Road. CHP began reopening it.

local.h: Case dismissed for OC woman whose dog voted
local.b: Laura Lee Yourex, 64, of Costa Mesa won't serve time but must pay for four anti-voter-fraud billboards featuring her dog.
local.title: Case dismissed against OC woman who registered her dog to vote and cast ballots in two elections

local.h: Rancho Palos Verdes eyes resort tax for landslides
local.b: Measure RS would raise the overnight tax at Terranea Resort. The city expects to have spent about $75 million on landslide damage by mid-2027.
local.title: Rancho Palos Verdes turns to its best known attraction to help pay for landslide damages

local.h: Tompkins Square Park makeover splits regulars
local.b: A community board committee backed renovating the basketball courts, kids' pool and 1990s outdoor fitness area. Some park users say it goes too far.
local.title: Tompkins Square Park is getting a makeover. Some say it's too much.

local.h: Pfizer Building fix: 1/64th of an inch at a time
local.b: Engineering plans for the city's largest office-to-housing conversion show crews will jack sagging floors up about 7 inches in tiny increments.
local.title: Inside the plan to fix the nearly collapsed Pfizer Building, 1/64th of an inch at a time

local.h: Storms, wind and chill hit NYC weather
local.b: Temperatures drop from near 80 Thursday to the 50s by Saturday, with potentially dangerous storms Friday evening, the NWS says.
local.title: NYC’s whiplash weather continues into weekend with heavy winds, chilly temps, NWS says

local.h: Mamdani urges parking lots to ban ICE
local.b: The mayor and more than 100 elected officials asked lot and garage owners not to make their property available to ICE as a staging ground.
local.title: Mamdani and 100+ NY officials urge parking lot owners to ban ICE

local.h: NYC ambulance response times up 41%
local.b: A city comptroller's report found EMS teams are taking longer to reach people even as life-threatening emergencies rise.
local.title: NYC ambulance response times have grown 41% as life-threatening calls rise

local.h: Judge tosses Trump suit over NYC sanctuary laws
local.b: A federal judge dismissed the administration's lawsuit challenging the city's limits on cooperating with immigration authorities.
local.title: Federal judge tosses Trump administration lawsuit challenging NYC sanctuary laws

local.h: Queens mother charged in 5-year-old's death
local.b: Police charged Francis Cabello, 32, with murder in the death of her daughter Fabiana in Richmond Hill, a day after she called 911.
local.title: Death of Queens girl may be due to asphyxia, DA says

local.h: Bayeux Tapestry will be displayed flat
local.b: Culture Minister Catherine Pégard said the fragile 68-metre tapestry will go on an inclined table, not hang, when it returns from London next year.

local.h: 1 in 5 French would weigh leaving if Le Pen wins
local.b: An Ifop poll found 21 percent would consider settling abroad if the RN candidate wins in May 2027.

local.h: Macron urges calm before nationwide protests
local.b: Paris banned protests in the city centre ahead of Saturday's cost-of-living rallies, which authorities fear could turn violent.
local.title: Macron calls for calm amid fears of violence at France protests

local.h: French rugby players stranded at UK airport
local.b: Louis Bielle-Biarrey and three teammates were denied entry at Bristol Airport without valid UK travel permits, on the eve of their Champions Cup opener against Gloucester.

local.h: Charity wants alcohol labeled 'dangerous'
local.b: La Ligue contre le cancer is pressing 2027 presidential candidates to change ad warnings to say alcohol itself is dangerous to health.

local.h: Renton may let its Flock camera contract lapse
local.b: The city's license plate cameras have been off since May, and its nearly $170,000 contract expires Nov. 2.
local.title: After fierce debate, why Renton might let its Flock contract expire

local.h: Social housing agency plans Central District units
local.b: Seattle's social housing developer will build 20 units, mostly for families, next to the Central District library, aiming to open by 2028.
local.title: Seattle’s social housing agency unveils plans for 20-unit project in Central District

local.h: UW report: feds tap WA driver data for ICE arrests
local.b: The UW Center for Human Rights traced four ways immigration enforcement accesses driver and vehicle records, in violation of state laws.
